description: This file is a Java Spring MVC Controller managing customer option values in an admin panel. It provides endpoints for listing, editing, creating, saving, paginating, and deleting customer option values, interfacing with service layers and handling HTTP requests and responses.

classes.name: CustomerOptionsValueController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for managing customer option values in the admin interface.

methods.name: displayOptionValues
methods.description: Displays the list view of customer option values.

methods.name: displayOptionValueEdit
methods.description: Displays the edit form for a specific customer option value.

methods.name: displayOptionValueCreate
methods.description: Displays the creation form for new customer option value.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Internal method for rendering create/edit option value form.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles the POST request to save or update a customer option value.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Returns paginated list of customer option values in JSON format.

methods.name: deleteOptionValue
methods.description: Deletes a customer option value via AJAX request.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Utility method to set active menu context in the model.
